blocking: A PRODUCTION-REACHABLE advisory at HIGH or CRITICAL blocks the merge. Production-reachable means: reachable from the `dependencies` of a SHIPPED workspace (the root, apps/web, apps/product-page, packages/core, packages/shared, packages/design-system) or from the Deno gateway's npm imports, following the lockfile's own `dependencies` and `optionalDependencies` edges.

A DEV-ONLY advisory at CRITICAL blocks the merge. Dev-only means: reachable only from a `devDependencies` entry, or from a workspace that is not deployed (apps/mobile and apps/desktop are v1.x LOCKED per 16_Platform_Delivery_Sequence.md; the superseded apps/services/* microservice split and the dead packages/security workspace were deleted on 2026-10-21 and are no longer workspaces at all).
A DEV-ONLY advisory at HIGH or below is REPORTED and does not block. A gate that can never be green is a gate nobody reads (AGENTS.md §2 Rule 9).
policy.reached_from: The reachability graph is computed from bun.lock (the npm workspaces) plus the Deno gateway's npm imports. peerDependencies are NOT followed: a peer is a contract, not a shipped edge, and following them made packages that the product never loads look production-reachable.
policy.authority: 23_Security_Harness_Plan.md §5.1 (the CI gate order) and §12.1 G-SEC-1 ('No P0/S1 vulnerability open' — `pr-security / osv-scanner` clean, block deploy).
policy.review: Every entry below carries a reason and an expiry date. An EXPIRED entry is a hard failure of the gate itself (scripts/osv-audit.ts exits 1 before it scans), because an allowlist that silently rots is not an allowlist.
policy.history: Two `tinypool@1.1.1` CRITICAL entries (GHSA-5gmw-xhrv-c9v3, GHSA-85c8-ppgw-ccpr) were carried on 2026-10-21 while the design-system package still used vitest 3.2.7, which forced the vulnerable worker pool. Unifying the whole repository on vitest 4.1.12 removed the nested vitest 3, the nested @vitest/mocker 3.2.7 and the tinypool 1.x chain, so both entries were DELETED rather than left to rot.

entries.reason: Sandbox Breakout / Arbitrary Code Execution in sandbox. Transitive dependency of the `vercel` CLI (root devDependency) — it is not loaded by any shipped application code. No fixed version is published for the 3.x line (npm latest is 4.9.0, a major bump the Vercel CLI does not accept), so there is no upgrade that removes the finding without breaking the consumer.
